name: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival - Studio Ghibli Pack
summary:
This DLC is playable in Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival game modes like Taiko Mode, Great Drum Toy War and Run! Ninja Dojo.

STUDIO GHIBLI Pack contains 5 songs: "The Path of the Wind", "A Town with an Ocean View", "Ponyo on the Cliff by the Sea", "Carrying You" and "Merry-Go-Round of Life".

The songs included in this product may also be available in the Taiko Music Pass.
